text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Observations from the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13 and GFC-2023-v1.11) both indicate a tree-cover loss event of 4.5 hectares in 2023. Additionally, the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset corroborates that the event area was fully mapped as forest in 2020. The event meets the corroboration rule, which requires agreement from a later year in the series and the JRC 2020 reference on at least 50% of the event area. The forest type over the event area is primarily planted forest.
